_meta.description: Comprehensive attack dataset — 220 cases across 20 attack classes. Designed for maximum coverage of OWASP Top-10, evasion techniques, emerging vectors, and framework-specific probes. All cases expect X-WAF-Action: block unless noted.

sqli.description: SQL injection — classic, blind, time-based, stacked, OOB, second-order, polyglot

xss.description: Cross-site scripting — reflected, stored, DOM, CSP bypass, polyglot, SVG, MathML, event handlers

path_traversal.description: Path traversal — classic, encoded, double-encoded, Windows, null byte, beyond-root, absolute path

ssrf.description: Server-side request forgery — cloud metadata, internal services, DNS rebinding, URL credentials, protocol abuse

command_injection.description: OS command injection — Unix/Windows, semicolon, pipe, backtick, $(), substitution, blind

header_injection.description: Header injection — CRLF, host override, cache poisoning, request splitting, X-Forwarded-Host

recon.description: Recon paths — classic sensitive files, framework endpoints, cloud-native, CI/CD, admin panels

xxe.description: XML External Entity injection — classic, parameter entity, SSRF via XXE, blind OOB, SVG XXE

ssti.description: Server-Side Template Injection — Jinja2, Twig, Freemarker, Velocity, Pebble, Handlebars

nosql_injection.description: NoSQL injection — MongoDB operator injection, JSON query manipulation

log4shell.description: Log4Shell / Log4j JNDI injection — CVE-2021-44228 and variants

open_redirect.description: Open redirect — URL parameter abuse, protocol-relative, whitelisted domain bypass

http_smuggling.description: HTTP request smuggling — CL.TE, TE.CL, TE.TE obfuscation, chunked encoding abuse

rce_deserialization.description: RCE via deserialization — Java, PHP, Python pickle, Node.js

cases.label: Python pickle via base64
cases.notes: base64 of pickle that calls os.system('id')

ldap_injection.description: LDAP injection — attribute injection, filter bypass, wildcard dump

graphql_abuse.description: GraphQL specific attacks — introspection, batching, DoS, field fuzzing
